newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate climbs above five percent.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate climbs above five percent.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate climbed above the five-percent mark at mid-session on Tuesday following the central bank's announcement that it would issue T$12 billion in negotiable certificates of deposits, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate rose to 5.002 percent against Monday's 4.958 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.95-5.00 percent against 5.00.
The central bank had said on Monday it would seek to keep the rates above the five-percent level.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1000 percent against 6.0950. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
